_readme: Copy to the covers folder next to record.json as packages.json and fill in the covers. type '' = every insurance type. base_cover: ΑΣΤΙΚΗ ΕΥΘΥΝΗ | ΠΥΡΟΣ - ΚΛΟΠΗ | ΙΔΙΕΣ ΖΗΜΙΕΣ | '' ; optional_covers: any of ΘΡΑΥΣΗ ΚΡΥΣΤΑΛΛΩΝ, ΝΟΜΙΚΗ ΠΡΟΣΤΑΣΙΑ, ΟΔΙΚΗ ΒΟΗΘΕΙΑ (the covers the package already includes). company/type must equal the names in record.json. 'included' and 'available_options' are notes for people, the app ignores them.
